text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Channel One agrees to cooperate with police in investigation on appointment of attorney-general but refuses to name sources.
- Arafat: Israel will not decide alone on scope of future West Bank redeployments.
- Israeli army's logistics department drafts plan to save 1.1 billion shekels.
- Researchers say 1,000 deaths every year in Israel related to air pollution.
- Channel One: Prime minister not involved in Bar-On affair.
- Report: Syria accepts 242 as basis for talks.
- Acting attorney-general, police to confer today on Bar-On probe.
- Senior source: "Prime Minister and top aide willing to undergo lie-detector tests".
- Israeli woman, 28, dies of flu complication.
